t: You're standing at the statue of the 1st Marquess of Westminster, at the corner of Wilton and Grosvenor Crescents in Belgravia. It shows Robert Grosvenor, who owned and developed the surrounding Grosvenor estate. The sculptor was Jonathan Wylder, and the statue was commissioned in 1998 by Gerald Grosvenor, the 6th Duke of Westminster. He was a landowner, businessman and Territorial Army general, who chaired the Grosvenor Group property company.
